name: Single Parenting
overview: Scripture reveals God's original design for companionship in Genesis 2:18, where He declares it is not good for man to be alone, instituting marriage as a divine provision. While Deuteronomy 24:1 acknowledges the reality of marital breakdown through divorce, the Bible upholds marriage as honorable and undefiled in Hebrews 13:4, warning against unfaithfulness. In the midst of single parenting, Isaiah 54:5 reminds believers that God Himself is the ultimate husband and Redeemer, providing comfort and strength beyond human relationships.
